tools.name: search_beacons
tools.description: Search beacons on AgentBeacon: each a few plain words about what someone has or needs right now, live while they renew it. Describe what the person needs in their own words, with a place if it matters ("plumber free tomorrow near 78704", "line cook jobs in Austin"). Results mix offers and requests.

tools.name: read_beacon
tools.description: Read one beacon by the id at the end of its Link line: its current words, with any phone, email or link it gives (search shows them masked), its location, when it expires, and what AgentBeacon checked about who is behind it. Use it before messaging or calling, to see the latest version.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "search" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_beacon · Private data: search_beacons · Public sink: read_beacon.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_beacon · Private data: search_beacons · Public sink: read_beacon

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
